extracted.intended_audience: developers, data users, and researchers using the Regulations.gov API (e.g., app developers, data scientists, agency integrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules, constraints, and practical guidance for querying Regulations.gov programmatically (documents, comments, and dockets) via the v4 API, including authentication, available fields, pagination, rate limits, and example queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: API key required and X-Api-Key header
rubrics_metrics.description: To begin using this API, you will need to register for an API Key. After registration, you will need to provide this API key in the X-Api-Key HTTP header with every API request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you want to use commenting API, you MUST use the form below to register for an API key. For sample purposes you can use DEMO_KEY but it is for demonstration only and should not be used beyond exploring the APIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documents search endpoint (/v4/documents)
rubrics_metrics.description: /v4/documents supports searching for a list of documents: full text keyword searches and filtering based on a number of available parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: filter[searchTerm]=water, filter[postedDate]=2020-09-01, filter[postedDate][ge]=2020-09-01&filter[postedDate][le]=2020-09-01, sort=postedDate (asc), sort=-postedDate (desc). Note: some data moved from v3 to detail endpoints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document detail endpoint (/v4/documents/{documentId}) and document types
rubrics_metrics.description: Use /v4/documents/{documentId} to obtain detailed information for a single document. A document is defined as Proposed Rule, Rule, Supporting & Related, or Other. Documents may be part of a Rulemaking or Nonrulemaking Docket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attachments are not included by default; you can include attachments using include=attachments. The document JSON response contains documentId (returned as an Id of the document). There are attributes that vary by Agency posting the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments search endpoint (/v4/comments)
rubrics_metrics.description: /v4/comments supports searching for a list of comments: full text keyword searches and filtering based on a number of available parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: filter[searchTerm]=water, filter[postedDate]=2020-09-01, filter[postedDate][ge]=...&filter[postedDate][le]=..., filter[commentOnId]=<objectId>, sort=postedDate (asc/desc).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment detail endpoint (/v4/comments/{commentId})
rubrics_metrics.description: Use /v4/comments/{commentId} to obtain detailed information for a single comment. Each comment has attributes that vary based on the Agency posting the comment and whether it's part of a Rulemaking or Nonrulemaking docket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attachments are not included by default; include attachments with include=attachments (e.g., ?include=attachments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket search endpoint (/v4/dockets)
rubrics_metrics.description: /v4/dockets can be used to search for dockets (organizational folders containing multiple documents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: filter[searchTerm]=water, filter[searchTerm]=EPA-HQ-OAR-2003-0129, filter[agencyId]=GSA,EPA, sort=title (asc/desc).

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket detail endpoint (/v4/dockets/{docketId})
rubrics_metrics.description: Use /v4/dockets/{docketId} to retrieve detailed information for a single docket. Docket attributes vary by Agency and whether the docket is Rulemaking or Nonrulemaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: https://api.regulations.gov/v4/dockets/EPA-HQ-OAR-2003-0129?api_key=DEMO_KEY. Some fields (e.g., RIN) moved to docket details and are not returned by /documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of fields always publicly viewable on a comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain fields are always available in the JSON response for a comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always-public fields: agencyId, comment, commentOnId, docketId, documentId, documentType, postedDate, receiveDate, restrictReason (if restrictReasonType is 'Other'), restrictReasonType (if the document is restricted), reasonWithdrawn (if the comment has been withdrawn), title, trackingNbr, withdrawn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency-configurable comment fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies can toggle access to certain comment fields at any time; these fields may appear or not in the comment JSON response depending on agency configuration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency-configurable fields: city, country, docAbstract, firstName, govAgency, govAgencyType, lastName, legacyId, organization, pageCount, postmarkDate, stateProvinceRegion, subtype, zip. For agency-specific commenting practices contact eRulemaking@gsa.gov. The OpenAPI spec includes info on agency-configurable fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields never publicly viewable on a comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Some fields are never returned in public comment JSON responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Never-public fields: originalDocumentId, address1, address2, email, phone, fax.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data limitations and agency-managed fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain aspects of the commenting process and some data fields are managed solely by agencies, which can create limitations for external users of public comment data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A GAO report raised concerns that comment data may not be fully described to the public. For agency-specific practices or missing fields contact eRulemaking@gsa.gov. The OpenAPI Specification has been updated with agency-configurable field info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict pagination limits in v4 and recommended bulk retrieval pattern
rubrics_metrics.description: v4 has strict pagination limits (page sizes and total pages). To retrieve very large result sets (e.g., >5000 comments), follow a multi-step paging and filtering strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example procedure for >5000 comments: 1) Get documents for docketId and note objectId for each document. 2) Query comments by commentOnId. 3) Page through first set using page[size]=250&page[number]=N with N between 1 and 20 to retrieve first 5000. Sort by lastModifiedDate,documentId. 4) On last page record lastModifiedDate and run subsequent queries with filter[lastModifiedDate][ge]=<last_date_converted_to_Eastern_time> and repeat paging to retrieve next sets. Repeat until all comments retrieved. Note: page[size]=250 and page[number] 1..20 used in examples; lastModifiedDate parameter is in beta and may be removed when a permanent bulk solution is available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of lastModifiedDate filter (beta) when paginating
rubrics_metrics.description: The lastModifiedDate parameter can be used as a filter to continue paginating large result sets without missing items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When moving to the next batch, filter by lastModifiedDate >= the last item's lastModifiedDate from the previous batch. Be careful with time zone conversions (example: 2020-08-10T15:58:52Z → 2020-08-10 11:58:52 Eastern). Note: lastModifiedDate is beta and may be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commenting API rate limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Commenting API is subject to rate limits: 50 requests per minute and a secondary limit of 500 requests per hour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General API rate-limit guidance is at https://api.data.gov/docs/rate-limits/. Respect these limits to avoid throttling; use DEMO_KEY only for exploration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rate limit increase policy
rubrics_metrics.description: GSA may grant a rate limit increase on GET keys for an indefinite period on a case-by-case basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests for higher limits must establish need to justify increases; each submission will be reviewed and considered individually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document status via withdrawn field
rubrics_metrics.description: The /v4/documents response includes a withdrawn boolean field indicating document status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If withdrawn = true, the document is withdrawn; otherwise the document is posted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments handling (include parameter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachments are not returned by default for document or comment details; include attachments explicitly using the include parameter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: /v4/documents/{documentId}?include=attachments&api_key=DEMO_KEY and /v4/comments/{commentId}?include=attachments&api_key=DEMO_KEY.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported query parameters and common filters
rubrics_metrics.description: The API supports common filters and sorting for searches across documents, comments, and dockets using filter[...] and sort parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Common examples shown: filter[searchTerm], filter[postedDate], filter[postedDate][ge]/[le], filter[commentOnId], filter[docketId], filter[agencyId], sort=postedDate or sort=-postedDate, sort=title or sort=-title. Use these to refine searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: OpenAPI specification and staging environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Full API details are available in the OpenAPI Specification file; a staging API is available for testing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open API specification file link provided on the page. Staging API URL: https://api-staging.regulations.gov — use staging for testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples as authoritative usage patterns
rubrics_metrics.description: The documentation provides concrete example queries demonstrating searches, filters, sorting, paging, and how to retrieve attachments or details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Copy/paste-ready examples include searches by term/dates/commentId/documentId, sorting, and the multi-step approach for retrieving very large comment sets (document list → commentByObjectId → paginated retrieval). Use examples as templates for constructing queries.
